title: feat(v3face): fill-from-(1,0,0) is not equivalent to vertex3=1
science: A genuine correction of the naive reading of #6444/#6446, and a real class-level negative. Scoring all 32 F_cut maps on fill-from-(1,0,0): N_fill=4, N_v3=16, N_both=4, so 'fills from the shared-face seed' is NOT equivalent to vertex3=1. The implication runs one way only - fill implies vertex3=1, but 12 of the 16 vertex3=1 maps do not fill - with lex-first counterexample (0,0,0,1,0), which fires vertex3 yet halts at lock-count 1 because the first neighbourhoods of (1,0,0) are wt1 or empty and it silences wt1. What the shared-face seed actually detects is the CONJUNCTION wt1=adj2=vertex3=1; the four fillers are (1,0,1,1,0), (1,0,1,1,1)=f_L1, (1,1,1,1,0), (1,1,1,1,1). The 'cov1=12 iff vertex3=1' of #6444 is thus valid only inside the k=4 class and fails class-wide.
verdict_pair: reverse=none face=none (no (reverse,face) pair stated; pre-verdict campaign phase)
